steps.text: Talk to Alan in Tal Teok Temple, north of Tal Teklan, to start the quest.
Inspect the egg in front of you.
Head south into Tal Teklan and talk to King in the pub.
Get an empty bowl from the pub, will need it later. If it's not there, hop worlds or wait for it to spawn again.
Talk to Acatzin inside the Tal Teklan pub.
choices: I can talk to the blacksmith.

steps.text: Talk to the Blacksmith west of the Tal Teklan pub.
Get the hammer from the table. If it's not there, hop worlds or wait for it to spawn again.
Get some nails from the blacksmith's workbench, we'll need them later.
Get the Saw from the house to the south, we'll need it later. If it's not there, hop worlds or wait for it to spawn again.
Fix the whetstone.
Talk to the Blacksmith again after fixing the whetstone to receive a damaged axe.
Repair the axe on the whetstone.
Return the repaired axe to Acatzin in the Tel Teklan pub.
Talk to Kauayotl at the east entrance of Tal Teklan.
choices: I see. Well, maybe I can help out with that?

steps.text: Talk to Kauayotl again after repairing his cart.
Repair Kauayotl's cart.
Go south-west of Kauayotl and pick up two planks from besides the lake. If it's not there, hop worlds or wait for it to spawn again.
Pick the damiana bush at the east entrance of Tal Teklan for some damiana leaves, we'll need these later.
Talk to Nezketi in the Tal Teklan temple.
choices: I can get you some tea.

steps.text: Fill your empty bowl with water at the water pump near the eastern entrance of Tal Teklan.
Mix damiana leaves with your bowl of water.
Use your bowl of damiana water on the stove in the east part of Tal Teklan to boil it.
Pour the damiana tea from your bowl into the empty cup
Return to Nezketi in the Tal Teklan temple and give him the cup of damiana tea.
Return to the temple north of Tal Teklan and speak with one of King's men.
Search the Eggs to get a Large egg.
Kill the large chicken.
Fetch the Large egg from the chicken coop south of the large temple. Be ready to fight a level 17 chicken.
Step across the log balance towards the dragon cave.
Search the Eggs in the dragon cave.
Fight the red dragon. You can safespot it by standing south-east of the Eggs.
Search the Eggs in the south-east of the dragon cave to collect your Dragon egg.
Fetch the Dragon egg from the dragon cave south-east of the large temple, across the river. Be ready to fight a Red dragon.
Exit the dragon's cave.
Fight the Jaguar. You can safespot it by standing just north east of the camp.
Search the Eggs at the camp, east of the dragon age, and collect your Jaguar egg.
Fetch the Jaguar egg from the tent, east of the dragon cave. Be ready to fight a level 88 jaguar.
Return to the temple north of Tal Teklan with the egg replacements and speak with one of "King"'s men.
Give Kauayotl the Dragon egg.
Give Nezketi the Jaguar egg.
Give Acatzin the Large egg.
Give the eggs to King's men at the Tal Teok Temple, north of Tal Teklan.
Return to the large temple north of Tal Teklan and talk with one of King's men to evaluate the Humphrey Dumphrey alternatives.
Talk to one of King's men to figure out how to solve the broken-egg conundrum.
Inspect the egg.
Put Lumpty Mumpty back together again.
Talk to one of King's men to finish the quest.
Solve the puzzle by following the instructions in the overlay.
Rotate the piece until you're prompted to move it to the correct spot. The square of the egg piece and the square marking the correct spot need to roughly line up.

panels.header: Humphrey Dumphrey sat on a wall
Wumty Scrumpty had a great fall
All the king's horses and all the king's men...
Couldn't put Bumpty Numpty back together again...
